ycy config cm set
Set an optional commit message provider profile value
Usage:
  ycy config cm set <profile> <key> <value> [flags]
Flags:
  -h, --help	help for set
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
